assetSources.note: Existing fictional project assets reused for this workflow stress test.

deliveryProfile.label: TikTok Photo Mode · organic

slideCount.note: Glyphkiln still treats two or more slides as a carousel sequence; there is no universal optimal count.

acceptedImageMediaTypes.note: TikTok's native help does not publish an exact file-type contract; verify the target device picker.

aspectRatio.note: 3:4 is a Glyphkiln working canvas, not an official organic Photo Mode requirement.

raster.note: 1080 px is a Glyphkiln working target, not a universal native Photo Mode requirement.

accessibility.note: Supply alt text for every meaningful image in the sequence.

surfaceOverlay.note: No stable first-party organic Photo Mode safe zone is published; verify against captured live UI.

authoringNotes: Do not import Smart Order, 9:16, or 3/7–9 slide advice from the paid-ad path.
Proof the advisory overlay against current device captures before publishing.

qualityIssues.message: The final line is isolated or disproportionately short.

issues.message: Every slide uses the same composition variant; review visual rhythm without weakening brand continuity.
